title: Are the #Israelites “#Men only”?? Get to know the #DaughtersOfSarah of #IUICArkansas
cleanTitle: Are the “ only”?? Get to know the of
segments: Shalom, Christ bless. This Naomi here
from the house of Officer Emmanuel, IYC
Arkansas. With me I have
Sis Joanna, IYC Arkansas.
All praises. So, Sis Joanna, how long
have you been in the truth?
I've been in the the congregation for 3
years.
All praises. So, who is your favorite
foremother and why?
My favorite foremother is Judith because
she used her meekness, faith, and wisdom
to save her nation and she also fasted
often.
All praises. Thank you, sis. Shalom
family, Most High and Christ bless. This
Naomi here from the house of Officer
Emmanuel, IYC Arkansas. With me I have
Shalom, I'm Sis Marissa.
All praises. So, Sis Marissa, how long
have you been in the truth?
Um almost a year. I think it's 9 months.
All praises. Okay, so who is your
favorite foremother and why?
Um my favorite foremother is Susanna
because she stood tall in her faith and
she had faith that the Most High was
going to see her through whatever and
did not abandon her righteousness.
